facts.fact: According to IAB's latest research, up to 75% of marketers say today's leading advanced measurement approaches fall short of meeting core needs such as rigor, timeliness, trust, and efficiency.

facts.fact: StackAdapt reports that 52% of US brand and agency marketers use incrementality experiments to measure campaigns, citing eMarketer.
facts.quote: using incrementality experiments to measure campaigns

facts.fact: According to IAB, marketers expect AI to increase measurement frequency by 2–3X over the next 1–2 years.
facts.quote: marketers expect it to increase measurement frequency by 2–3X and automate more strategic work over the next 1–2 years

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that ad platforms must decide within milliseconds whether to bid on an available ad impression and how much to pay.
facts.quote: must decide within milliseconds whether to bid on it and how much to pay

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that ad auctions operate on millisecond-level timeframes, which makes speed of ML predictions a central challenge.
facts.quote: as ad auctions operate on millisecond-level timeframes

facts.fact: Propensity to convert is not the same as incrementality, because a person can be very likely to convert even if the ads made no difference.
facts.quote: The difference is that propensity isn’t incrementality. Someone can be very likely to convert even if your ads made no difference.

facts.fact: The page recommends marketing mix modeling (MMM) for higher-level planning and budget allocation over time, especially when user-level tracking is limited.
facts.quote: Use marketing mix modeling (MMM) for higher-level planning and budget allocation over time, especially when user-level tracking is limited.

facts.fact: The page advises using multi-touch attribution (MTA) for directional optimization insights but treating it as less definitive on causality.
facts.quote: Use multi-touch attribution (MTA) for directional optimization insights, but treat it as less definitive on causality.

facts.fact: The page states that SMBs are gaining the ability to leverage AI without requiring massive data sets, according to the vendor's own claim.
facts.quote: Small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs) are gaining the ability to leverage AI without requiring massive data sets.
